lock_profiling.root_cause_analysis: Under Windows msvcrt.locking, the advisory lock is exclusive across OS processes. Because namespace_write_lock wraps the entire learn() pipeline (deduplication query + SQLite WAL transaction + audit transaction), competing worker processes encounter a locked file and enter non-blocking retry loops with exponential backoff sleep (5-50ms). This backoff latency dominates multi-process wall clock time (~5 writes/s across 4 OS processes), whereas in-process multi-threading (106.3 writes/s) shares the cached ONNX model and in-memory data structures with zero OS file locking overhead.
